bugs.title: Finance vs Insights show CONTRADICTORY 'Outstanding' balances for the same data: -$250.00 vs $0.00 — two different formulas for the same stat
steps: Have an invoice with payments exceeding total (e.g. $1250 paid on $1000 invoice)
bugs.expected: Both screens should compute Outstanding consistently (e.g. both clamp to 0 or both show overpayment)
bugs.actual: Finance.tsx:123 computes totalOutstanding = totalInvoiced - totalPaidRevenue (payments-based, -$250.00 with overpayment); Insights.tsx:42 computes totalOutstanding = sum of invoice totals with status sent/partial/overdue (status-based, $0.00 since all marked paid). Identical data yields contradictory stats on the two pages
bugs.evidence: Finance Overview: '-$250.00' Outstanding; Insights: '$0.00' Outstanding 'all current' — same invoices/payments in localStorage
